## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical handling of log isolation in a single GCP project using Cloud Logging sinks, IAM Conditions, labels, and basic testing. It reveals understanding of preventing cross-tenant leakage and safe rollback.

## Key Concepts
- Cloud Logging sinks with per-tenant policy
- IAM Conditions on Logs permissions
- Log labeling and filters
- Tests for access isolation
- Rollback strategy

## Code Example
```javascript
const policy = {
  bindings: [
    {
      role: 'roles/logging.logWriter',
      members: ['serviceAccount:tenantA-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com'],
      condition: {
        title: 'TenantScope',
        description: 'tenant == tenantA',
        expression: `resource.labels.tenant == 'tenantA'`
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

- How would you test the policy at scale?
- How would you handle legitimate cross-tenant access needs?
